description: Makes a wa.me chat link and its QR code (an SVG image) for a WhatsApp number, with an opening message if one is given. country is the two-letter ISO code and number is the number exactly as it is typed in that country (as written at home, with +, with 00 or with the country code in front); a number of another country is refused. It sends nothing to anyone.

country.description: The country the number belongs to, as its two-letter ISO code: "GB", "US", "DE". A number of another country is refused.

message.description: The message the chat starts with, at most 500 characters. Left out or blank, the link opens an empty chat.

number.description: The WhatsApp number as people type it: as written at home (07700 900123), with + (+44 7700 900123), with 00 (0044 7700 900123) or with the country code in front (44 7700 900123). Spaces, dashes, brackets and digits in any script are fine.

name: whatsapp_link
title: Make a WhatsApp chat link
